definitions.explanation: The formal starting or launching of an organization, committee, project, or system.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{委員会|いいんかい}が{発足|ほっそく}した。
プロジェクトチームは{先月|せんげつ}{発足|ほっそく}したばかりだ。
examples.english: The project team was just launched last month.

examples.japanese: {市民|しみん}の{安全|あんぜん}を{守|まも}るための{対策|たいさく}{本部|ほんぶ}が{発足|ほっそく}し、{活動|かつどう}を{開始|かいし}した。
examples.english: A task force to protect citizens' safety was inaugurated and began operations.

notes:
PRONUNCIATION:
The standard reading is ほっそく. The reading はっそく is also sometimes heard but is considered less standard.

USAGE:
Used intransitively ({発足|ほっそく}する) to describe organizations, committees, or groups starting up. Also used as a noun modifier: {発足|ほっそく}{当初|とうしょ} (at the time of establishment).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {委員会|いいんかい}が{発足|ほっそく}する: a committee is launched
- {団体|だんたい}が{発足|ほっそく}する: an organization is established
- {発足|ほっそく}{当初|とうしょ}: at the time of inauguration
- {新|しん}{政権|せいけん}が{発足|ほっそく}する: a new administration is inaugurated

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {設立|せつりつ}: establishment, founding (focuses on the legal/formal creation)
- {創設|そうせつ}: founding (emphasizes being the very first)
